Senior Product Manager, Business Systems

Quo is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead enterprise resource planning for finance and operations. You will own the go-to-market rollout across three business units.

Required qualifications
- 5+ years of product management experience with enterprise resource planning systems.
- Hands-on NetSuite administration in a multi-subsidiary environment.
- Stakeholder management across finance, engineering, and support.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with micromobility operations at city scale.
- Roadmap planning for internal platforms.
